title: docs(lite): E10 omits critiqueLoop.delegate verdict resolution that the full-profile review-fix file has
body:
**Origin**: local-ahead correction in `kurone-kito/dotfiles` (dotfiles#421 / PR #430; registered as `dotfiles-divergence: lite-critique-delegate-parity` by dotfiles#425). Reconfirmed still absent from upstream lite template at `v0.12.0` (`11105d705820e50be0a14fcc174587abbaf62b30`) by dotfiles#452.

**File**: `idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/idd-review-fix-lite.instructions.md` (E10)

**Problem**: full-profile `idd-review-fix.instructions.md` resolves `critiqueLoop.delegate` (mode/command/fallback, union of delegate + per-agent findings). Upstream lite E10 still lacks that resolution. This repository mirrored it locally so lite sessions keep delegate-critique coverage (same pattern as `lite-telemetry-parity`, different phase).

`kurone-kito/idd-skill#2968` landed several lite/standard mirroring fixes at `v0.12.0`; this E10 delegate-verdict block was not among them.

**Suggested fix**: mirror the stock E10 delegate-verdict resolution steps into the lite review-fix file.

**Confirmed present** at `v0.12.0` by a direct diff of the local lite review-fix file against the pinned template.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Lite E10 resolves `critiqueLoop.delegate` mode/command/fallback and unions delegate findings with the per-agent pass, matching the full-profile file.
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` and markdownlint pass on the updated file.
